purpose: prove residual completion rigidity and isolate the exact moving-coefficient uniformity needed for a small-L power-saving count
proposed_small_L_lemma: I(B,T) <<_epsilon B^(1/2-eta+epsilon)*T^A for some eta>0 and finite A, uniformly in an explicit power range of T
essential_uniformity: moving primitive coefficients a:b and the bad-prime mass of the square-test forms Q1,Q2 across all exact physical-budget cells
